newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia peso ends down 4.8 amid speculation.
newsitem.headline: Colombia peso ends down 4.8 amid speculation.

text.p: Colombia's peso closed down 4.8 at 1,069.8 pesos to the dollar, rebounding from a midsession dive.
Interbank dealers said one of the main factors moving the markets Thursday was speculation by banks with some continued demand from business looking to make earlier foreign debt service payments.
Banks were keen to push up the peso rate in advance of balancing their month-end books, dealers said.
Traders reported 431 operations worth a total $184 million. The peso sank to an intraday low of 1,079.5 and hit an intraday high of 1,060.4 pesos per dollar.
